items.title: Agoda’s COO on AI Booking: ‘Nobody Knows’ the Business Model Yet
items.why: Agent-driven booking could reshape travel distribution; ask whether card travel portals need an agent strategy.
items.summary_ai: Agoda's COO says the economics of AI agent bookings are unclear, and agent commissions could matter more to margins than integrations.
items.take: Agent-driven booking could reshape travel distribution; ask whether card travel portals need an agent strategy.
